```{r}
#| label: aggregate to pathogen-level dataset
#-------------------------------
# 12 primary pathogens from SAP
# Antigen groups for each primary pathogen
#-------------------------------

antigen_map <- list(
  Campylobacter   = c("p18", "p39"),
  Cholera         = c("osp_inaba", "osp_ogawa"),      # exclude ctb due to cross-reactivity with ETEC LTB
  LT_ETEC         = c("etec"),
  Salmonella_BD   = c("salb", "sald"),                # Enteritidis + Typhimurium
  Salmonella_HlyE = c("hlye"),                        # Typhi/Paratyphi
  Shigella        = c("ipab"),
  Cryptosporidium = c("cp17", "cp23"),
  E_histolytica   = c("leca"),
  Giardia         = c("vsp5"),
  Strongyloides   = c("nie"),
  T_solium        = c("t24h", "es33"),
  Norovirus       = c("norogi5", "norogii3", "norogii4", "norogii6", "norogii17")
)

#-------------------------
# Prepare a dataset 
# one row per child × pathogen, 
# with seropos = 1 if child is positive to any antigen in that pathogen group
# Collapse antigen-level to pathogen-level
#-------------------------
# pathogen list
pathogen_labels <- c("Norovirus GI/GII","LT-ETEC (LTB)","Campylobacter (p18,p39)","Shigella/EIEC (IpaB)","S. enterica typhi (HlyE)","S. enterica (LPS B,D)","V. cholerae (OSP-Inaba/Ogawa)","Cryptosporidium (Cp17,Cp23)","Giardia (VSP-5)","E. histolytica (LecA)","T. solium (T24,Es33)","S. stercoralis (NIE)")

d_pathogen <- lapply(names(antigen_map), function(p) {
  d2 %>%
    filter(antigen %in% antigen_map[[p]]) %>%
    group_by(block, clusterid, wsh, wshf, nutr, nutrf, tr, childid, visit, agemonth) %>%
    summarise(seropos = as.integer(any(seropos == 1)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pathogen = p)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  # create pretty pathogen/antigen labels
  mutate(
    pathogenf = case_when(
      pathogen == "Norovirus" ~ "Norovirus GI/GII",
      pathogen == "LT_ETEC" ~ "LT-ETEC (LTB)",
      pathogen == "Campylobacter" ~ "Campylobacter (p18,p39)",
      pathogen == "Shigella" ~ "Shigella/EIEC (IpaB)",
      pathogen == "Salmonella_HlyE" ~ "S. enterica typhi (HlyE)",
      pathogen == "Salmonella_BD" ~ "S. enterica (LPS B,D)",
      pathogen == "Cholera" ~ "V. cholerae (OSP-Inaba/Ogawa)",
      pathogen == "Cryptosporidium" ~ "Cryptosporidium (Cp17,Cp23)",
      pathogen == "Giardia" ~ "Giardia (VSP-5)",
      pathogen == "E_histolytica" ~ "E. histolytica (LecA)",
      pathogen == "T_solium" ~ "T. solium (T24,Es33)",
      pathogen == "Strongyloides" ~ "S. stercoralis (NIE)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(NA)
    ), 
    pathogenf = factor(pathogenf, levels = pathogen_labels)
  )

#-------------------------
# filter the antigen-level
# dataset to just the enterics
#-------------------------
d3 <- d2 %>%
filter(antigen %in% unlist(antigen_map))

```


# Summary of age by visit

Visit 1 represents mainly maternal IgG responses, as nearly all measurements from visit 1 were among children <6 months old.

```{r}
#| label: Examine age distributions

#---------------------------------
d3_child <- d3 %>% group_by(sampleid) %>% slice(1)
by(data=d3_child,d3_child$visit,function(x) summary(x$agemonth))
by(data=d3_child,d3_child$visit,function(x) sd(x$agemonth, na.rm=TRUE))

plot_age_visit <- ggplot(d3_child, aes(x=agemonth,fill=factor(visit)),group=(visit)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha=0.7,bins=40, position = "identity") +
```

# Marginal means by visit

```{r}
#| label: estimate marginal means and effects in visit 1 2 3

#-------------------------
# flip the factor levels
# for emmeans to make
# the No category the 
# reference
#-------------------------
d_pathogen2 <- d_pathogen %>%
  mutate(wshf = relevel(wshf,ref="WASH"),
         nutrf = relevel(nutrf,ref="Nutrition")
         )

#-------------------------
# estimate marginal means
# and differences
# for visits 1,2,3
#-------------------------
marg_means_by_visit <- 
  foreach(visiti = 1:3, .combine = rbind) %:% 

    foreach(ii = 1:length(pathogen_labels), .combine = rbind) %do% {
  
    di <- d_pathogen2 %>%
    filter(visit==visiti, pathogenf == pathogen_labels[ii])

    # fit linear regression
    # if the final visit, control for matched pairs (block)
    # otherwise do not b/c EED substudy did not retain matched design
    if(visiti == 3) {
      fiti <- glm(seropos ~ wshf + nutrf + factor(block), data=di, family=gaussian(link="identity"))
    } else{
      fiti <- glm(seropos ~ wshf + nutrf, data=di, family=gaussian(link="identity"))
    }
    
    # estimate cluster-robust SEs
    fiti_vcovCL <- sandwich::vcovCL(fiti, cluster = di$clusterid)
    
    # estimate marginal means for each treatment margin, difference scale
    musi_wash <- emmeans(fiti, ~ wshf   , vcov = fiti_vcovCL)
    musi_nutr <- emmeans(fiti, ~ nutrf  , vcov = fiti_vcovCL)
    
    # estimate marginal contrasts
    diffi_wash <- pairs(musi_wash, simple = "each")
    diffi_nutr <- pairs(musi_nutr, simple = "each")
    
    # gather results
    res1 <- data.frame(musi_wash) %>% 
      rename(marginal_mean = wshf, se_mean = SE, df_mean = df)
    res2 <- data.frame(musi_nutr) %>% 
      rename(marginal_mean = nutrf,se_mean = SE, df_mean = df)
    res3 <- data.frame(diffi_wash) %>% mutate(marginal_mean = "WASH")
    res4 <- data.frame(diffi_nutr) %>% mutate(marginal_mean = "Nutrition")
    res5 <- left_join(res1,res3, join_by(marginal_mean))
    res6 <- left_join(res2,res4, join_by(marginal_mean))
    res7  <- bind_rows(res5,res6) %>% mutate(pathogenf = pathogen_labels[ii])

#-------------------------
# separate out the marginal
# means from the contrasts
#-------------------------
marg_means_vx <- res7 %>%
  mutate(visit = visiti) %>%
  select(pathogenf, visit, marginal_mean, emmean, se_mean, df_mean, min95=lower.CL, max95 = upper.CL)

# marg_diff_vx <- marg_effects_vx %>%
#   mutate(visit = i) %>%
#   filter(!is.na(contrast)) %>%
#   select(pathogen, visit, contrast, estimate, se=SE, df, t_val = t.ratio, p_value = p.value) %>%
#   mutate(min95 = estimate - 1.96*se, max95 = estimate + 1.96*se)

return(marg_means_vx)

    }

# format the pathogen label as a factor
marg_means_by_visit <- marg_means_by_visit %>%
  mutate(pathogenf = factor(pathogenf, levels=levels(d_pathogen2$pathogenf)),
         marginal_mean = factor(marginal_mean, levels=c("No WASH","WASH","No Nutrition","Nutrition")))

```




# Age-seroprev, 12-panel

## By WASH intervention 

```{r}
#| label: plot age-dependent seroprevalence by wash
#| warning: FALSE
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8
#-------------------------------
# create shade boxes to delineate
# different measurement timing
#-------------------------------
d_shade_box1 <- data.frame(minX=0,maxX=7.5)
d_shade_box2 <- data.frame(minX=18,maxX=33)

#-------------------------------
# set plot colors
# use color-blind intervention
# palette saved in config.R
# cbpal_int <- c("#2B2B2B", "#4C8C8A", "#D08C60","#8A8F73")
#-------------------------------
pcols <- cbpal_int


#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# age-seroprevalence by pathogen
#
# the reason we do a loop rather
# than simply use geom_smooth
# is to control the loess fit
#-------------------------------

# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels
pplots_wash <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen
  di <- d_pathogen %>% filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i])

  # fit loess by group and save predicted values
  fiti <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(wshf=="WASH"))
  fitc <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(wshf=="No WASH"))
  di_pred <- data.frame(agemonth=seq(3,28,by=0.1))
  di_pred$WASH <- predict(fiti, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred$Control <- predict(fitc, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred <- di_pred %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols=c(WASH,Control),names_to = "wshf", values_to = "pred") %>%
    mutate(wshf=factor(wshf,levels=c("Control","WASH"),labels=c("No WASH","WASH")))
  
  # shift seropos a bit for rug plots
  di <- di %>%
    mutate(
      seropos = ifelse(seropos==1,seropos+0.01,seropos - 0.01),
      seropos = case_when(
      wshf == "WASH" & seropos == 1.01 ~ 1.02,
      wshf == "No WASH" & seropos == -0.01 ~ -0.02,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(seropos))
           )
  
  # plot age seroprev
    pplots_wash[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=agemonth, y = seropos, group = wshf, color = wshf)) + 
      facet_wrap(.~pathogenf) +
  # draw shade boxes
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box1,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box2,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +

  # draw points
    geom_point(alpha=0.1, shape=95, size=0.1) +
    geom_line(data=di_pred, aes(x=agemonth,y=pred)) +

    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,by=6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[1:2], guide=guide_legend(title="")) +
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,1.02), xlim=c(0,30)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,0,5.5,5.5), "pt")
      )
  
}

#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# the marginal means
#-------------------------------
# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels
mplots_wash <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen & WASH contrasts
  di <- marg_means_by_visit %>% 
    filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i], marginal_mean %in% c("WASH","No WASH"))

  
  # plot marginally averaged seroprev
    mplots_wash[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=visit, y = emmean, color = marginal_mean)) +

  # draw points
   geom_vline(xintercept = c(1,2,3),linetype = "solid",color="gray90",lwd=0.25) +
    geom_point(position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2)),shape = 95, size=4) +
    geom_errorbar(data=di, aes(ymin = min95, ymax = max95), width=0.5,position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2))) +
        
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[1:2]) + # guide=guide_legend(title="")
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none", linetype = "none") +
    labs(x = "Visit", y = "") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,1.02), xlim=c(0.5,3.5)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,11,5.5,0), "pt")
      )
  
}


#-------------------------------
# combine the plots into a single
# figure
#-------------------------------
# plot_seroprev_wash <- pplots[[1]] + pplots[[2]] + pplots[[3]] + pplots[[4]] + pplots[[5]] + pplots[[6]] +

plot_seroprev_wash <- pplots_wash[[1]] + mplots_wash[[1]] + pplots_wash[[2]] + mplots_wash[[2]] +

  pplots_wash[[5]] + mplots_wash[[5]] + pplots_wash[[6]] + mplots_wash[[6]] +
  pplots_wash[[7]] + mplots_wash[[7]] + pplots_wash[[8]] + mplots_wash[[8]] + 
  pplots_wash[[9]] + mplots_wash[[9]] + pplots_wash[[10]] + mplots_wash[[10]] + 
  pplots_wash[[11]] + mplots_wash[[11]] + pplots_wash[[12]] + mplots_wash[[12]] +

ggsave(filename = here("output","washbb-age-seroprev-wash.png"),plot_seroprev_wash, device = "png", width=270,height=270,units="mm")
```

## By Nutrition intervention 

```{r}
#| label: plot age-dependent seroprevalence by nutrition
#| warning: FALSE
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8
#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# age-seroprevalence by pathogen
#
# the reason we do a loop rather
# than simply use geom_smooth
# is to control the loess fit
#-------------------------------

# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels
pplots_nutr <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen
  di <- d_pathogen %>% filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i])
  
  # fit loess by group and save predicted values
  fiti <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(nutrf=="Nutrition"))
  fitc <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(nutrf=="No Nutrition"))
  di_pred <- data.frame(agemonth=seq(3,28,by=0.1))
  di_pred$Nutrition <- predict(fiti, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred$Control <- predict(fitc, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred <- di_pred %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols=c(Nutrition,Control),names_to = "nutrf", values_to = "pred") %>%
    mutate(nutrf=factor(nutrf,levels=c("Control","Nutrition"),labels=c("No Nutrition","Nutrition")))
  
  # shift seropos a bit for rug plots
  di <- di %>%
    mutate(
      seropos = ifelse(seropos==1,seropos+0.01,seropos - 0.01),
      seropos = case_when(
      nutrf == "Nutrition" & seropos == 1.01 ~ 1.02,
      nutrf == "No Nutrition" & seropos == -0.01 ~ -0.02,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(seropos))
           )
  
    # plot age seroprev
    pplots_nutr[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=agemonth, y = seropos, group = nutrf, color = nutrf)) + 
      facet_wrap(.~pathogenf) +
  # draw shade boxes
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box1,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box2,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +

  # draw points
    geom_point(alpha=0.1, shape=95, size=0.1) +
    geom_line(data=di_pred, aes(x=agemonth,y=pred)) +

    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,by=6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[c(1,3)], guide=guide_legend(title="")) +
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,1.02), xlim=c(0,30)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,0,5.5,5.5), "pt")
      )
  
}

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {

}
```

# Age-seroprev, 6-panel

Consider slightly smaller figures by splitting into higher transmission pathogens and lower transmission pathogens. This allows us to zoom in the Y-axis scale for lower transmission pathogens to better display the data.

## By WASH intervention

```{r}
#| label: 6panel figure wash high transmission
#| warning: FALSE
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 8
#-------------------------------
# create shade boxes to delineate
# different measurement timing
#-------------------------------
d_shade_box1 <- data.frame(minX=0,maxX=7.5)
d_shade_box2 <- data.frame(minX=18,maxX=33)

#-------------------------------
# set plot colors
# use color-blind intervention
# palette saved in config.R
# cbpal_int <- c("#2B2B2B", "#4C8C8A", "#D08C60","#8A8F73")
#-------------------------------
pcols <- cbpal_int


#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# age-seroprevalence by pathogen
#
# the reason we do a loop rather
# than simply use geom_smooth
# is to control the loess fit
#-------------------------------

pathogen_labels_high <- c("Norovirus GI/GII","LT-ETEC (LTB)","Campylobacter (p18,p39)","Shigella/EIEC (IpaB)","Cryptosporidium (Cp17,Cp23)","Giardia (VSP-5)")

# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels_high
pplots_wash <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen
  di <- d_pathogen %>% filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i])

  # fit loess by group and save predicted values
  fiti <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(wshf=="WASH"))
  fitc <- loess(seropos ~ agemonth, data = di %>% filter(wshf=="No WASH"))
  di_pred <- data.frame(agemonth=seq(3,28,by=0.1))
  di_pred$WASH <- predict(fiti, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred$Control <- predict(fitc, newdata = di_pred)
  di_pred <- di_pred %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols=c(WASH,Control),names_to = "wshf", values_to = "pred") %>%
    mutate(wshf=factor(wshf,levels=c("Control","WASH"),labels=c("No WASH","WASH")))
  
  # shift seropos a bit for rug plots
  di <- di %>%
    mutate(
      seropos = ifelse(seropos==1,seropos+0.01,seropos - 0.01),
      seropos = case_when(
      wshf == "WASH" & seropos == 1.01 ~ 1.02,
      wshf == "No WASH" & seropos == -0.01 ~ -0.02,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(seropos))
           )
  
  # plot age seroprev
    pplots_wash[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=agemonth, y = seropos, group = wshf, color = wshf)) + 
      facet_wrap(.~pathogenf) +
  # draw shade boxes
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box1,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +
        geom_rect(data=d_shade_box2,aes(xmin = minX, xmax = maxX, ymin = 0, ymax = 1), inherit.aes=FALSE, alpha=0.05) +

  # draw points
    geom_point(alpha=0.1, shape=95, size=0.1) +
    geom_line(data=di_pred, aes(x=agemonth,y=pred)) +

    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,by=6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[1:2], guide=guide_legend(title="")) +
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,1.02), xlim=c(0,30)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,0,5.5,5.5), "pt")
      )
  
}

#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# the marginal means
#-------------------------------
# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels_high
mplots_wash <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen & WASH contrasts
  di <- marg_means_by_visit %>% 
    filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i], marginal_mean %in% c("WASH","No WASH"))

  
  # plot marginally averaged seroprev
    mplots_wash[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=visit, y = emmean, color = marginal_mean)) +

  # draw points
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1,2,3),linetype = "solid",color="gray90",lwd=0.25) +
    geom_point(position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2)),shape = 95, size=4) +
    geom_errorbar(data=di, aes(ymin = min95, ymax = max95), width=0.5,position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2))) +
        
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.2), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,1,by=0.2)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[1:2]) + # guide=guide_legend(title="")
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none", linetype = "none") +
    labs(x = "Visit", y = "") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,1.02), xlim=c(0.5,3.5)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,11,5.5,0), "pt")
      )
  
}


#-------------------------------
# combine the plots into a single
# figure
#-------------------------------

plot_seroprev_wash_high <- pplots_wash[[1]] + mplots_wash[[1]] + pplots_wash[[2]] + mplots_wash[[2]] + 
  pplots_wash[[3]] + mplots_wash[[3]] + pplots_wash[[4]] + mplots_wash[[4]] + 
  pplots_wash[[5]] + mplots_wash[[5]] + pplots_wash[[6]] + mplots_wash[[6]] +
  plot_layout(ncol=6,nrow=2, axes = "keep", guides = "collect",
              widths = rep(c(1,0.2),6)) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "A") & theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)) 

ggsave(filename = here("output","washbb-age-seroprev-wash_high.png"),plot_seroprev_wash_high, device = "png", width=260,height=150,units="mm")
```

```{r}
    labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "IgG seroprevalence (%)") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,0.37), xlim=c(0,30)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,0,5.5,5.5), "pt")
      )
  
}

#-------------------------------
# loop over pathogens and plot
# the marginal means
#-------------------------------
# get the list of pathogens 
pathogens <- pathogen_labels_low
mplots_nutr <- list()

for(i in 1:length(pathogens)) {
  
  # filter to the pathogen & WASH contrasts
  di <- marg_means_by_visit %>% 
    filter(pathogenf == pathogens[i], marginal_mean %in% c("Nutrition","No Nutrition"))

  
  # plot marginally averaged seroprev
    mplots_nutr[[i]] <- ggplot(data=di, aes(x=visit, y = emmean, color = marginal_mean)) +

  # draw points
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(1,2,3),linetype = "solid",color="gray90",lwd=0.25) +
     geom_point(position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2)),shape = 95, size=4) +
    geom_errorbar(data=di, aes(ymin = min95, ymax = max95), width=0.5,position = position_nudge(x=c(0.2,-0.2))) +
        
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,0.35,by=0.05), labels = sprintf("%1.0f",seq(0,0.35,by=0.05)*100)) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pcols[c(1,3)]) + 
    guides(color = "none", fill = "none", linetype = "none") +
    labs(x = "Visit", y = "") + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-0.02,0.37), xlim=c(0.5,3.5)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5,11,5.5,1), "pt")
      )
  
}


#-------------------------------
# combine the plots into a single
# figure
#-------------------------------
plot_seroprev_nutr_low <- pplots_nutr[[1]] + mplots_nutr[[1]] + pplots_nutr[[2]] + mplots_nutr[[2]] + 
  pplots_nutr[[3]] + mplots_nutr[[3]] + pplots_nutr[[4]] + mplots_nutr[[4]] + 
  pplots_nutr[[5]] + mplots_nutr[[5]] + pplots_nutr[[6]] + mplots_nutr[[6]] +
  plot_layout(ncol=6,nrow=2, axes = "keep", guides = "collect",
              widths = rep(c(1,0.2),6))  +
  plot_annotation(title = "B") & theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))

plot_seroprev_nutr_low

ggsave(filename = here("output","washbb-age-seroprev-nutr_low.png"),plot_seroprev_nutr_low, device = "png", width=260,height=150,units="mm")
```
